<caesura>

<caesura> marks the point at which a metrical line may be divided.
Attributes Global attributes and those inherited from phrase.verse
Example 
<l>Hw&ae;t we Gar-Dena <caesura/> in gear-dagum</l>
<l>&t;eod-cyninga <caesura/> &t;rym gefrunon,</l>
<l>hy &d;a &ae;&t;elingas <caesura/> ellen fremedon.</l>
